attributes.proposal_description:
Rare Network proposes the administration of a $500,000 USD Community-Led Marketing Fund to support Cardano ecosystem contributors produce diverse marketing campaigns globally. This initiative aims to position Cardano as a leader in blockchain by increasing visibility, engagement, and adoption.

 For the most optimal way to gain an understanding of our proposal, please see our deck first for visual: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1w_qzhCld5jRBFDUc8yHtir756rVFotMr

Challenges Identified
	· Lack of Cardano Marketing: Limited community-led marketing campaigns promoting the ecosystem.
	· Insufficient Funding: Compared to competitor Layer-1 blockchains, Cardano lacks financial support for grass roots marketing campaigns.
	· Inefficient Funding Mechanisms: Existing structures are impractical for marketing campaigns due to HR costs, overhead, and timing constraints.
	· Lack of SOPs: No standard operating procedures exist to maintain brand integrity and effective project management.

Proposed Solution
Rare Network will administer a marketing campaign fund allowing community members to launch meaningful marketing campaigns. The key components include:
	· Specialized Proposal System: Ensuring equitable access to funding.
	· Diverse Budget Allocation: Providing funds between $1,000 and $30,000 USD for a wide range of campaign scopes and budgets.
	· Efficient Administration: Ensuring fair distribution and transparent management.
	· Brand Integrity: Developing SOPs and brand guidelines to maintain alignment with Cardano’s values.
	· Transparent Reporting: Documenting successes, challenges, and impact.

Campaign Categories & Eligibility
Funding is open to individuals, organizations, and collaborations within the Cardano community. Marketing campaigns may include:
	· Product Launches
	· General Cardano Ecosystem Promotion
	· Content Creation
	· Social Media Campaigns
	· PR
	· Omnichannel Marketing Strategies


Funding Process
	1. Submit Proposal: Applications through an online portal.
	2. Review & Approval: Evaluation by Rare Network and shared with GMC/MWG for feedback.
	3. Fund Distribution: Dynamic allocation based on marketing campaign type and budgetary needs.
	4. Close-Out Report: Recipients must provide reports, KPIs, and media documentation.

Selection Criteria
	· Regional Diversity: Supporting marketing campaigns across different regions.
	· Marketing Experience: Ensuring high-quality execution.
	· Impact: Driving innovation and engagement.
	· Resource Optimization: Ensuring effective use of funds.

Administrative Costs & Timeline
	· A 15% administration fee will cover planning, proposal management, project management, and reporting to compensate Rare Network for their efforts.
	· Funding available from July 1, 2025 – March 31, 2026.

Strategic Alignment with Cardano’s Product Roadmap
	· Ecosystem Growth: Increasing exposure and driving global adoption.
	· Developer Engagement: Fostering marketing campaigns that not only target consumers, but also builders.
	· Collaboration: Aligning with the Growth & Marketing Committee (GMC), other Intersect committees, and Cardano’s founding entities.
	· Brand Strengthening: Showcasing Cardano’s innovation through impactful marketing campaigns.
	· Community Feedback Loop: Using marketing campaigns to refine strategies and improve ecosystem development.

Conclusion
Rare Network, a trusted partner within the Cardano ecosystem, has a proven track record of successfully managing community-driven initiatives. With endorsement from Intersect, GMC, Cardano Foundation, Emurgo, and IOG, this proposal ensures a sustainable, well-organized, and impactful community-led marketing campaign fund program.

Without a coordinated and impactful marketing strategy,
Cardano risks being overshadowed in a competitive
landscape. A fresh approach to marketing is essential to
position Cardano as the leader in the blockchain space.

showcasing Cardano and those building on it at the community level
- Insufficient funding for community-led marketing in
comparison to competitor layer-1 blockchains

the unique challenges of deploying marketing campaigns properly (ie. lack of working capital, HR payments during the work rather than retroactive, timed based on catalyst funding rounds and cumbersome milestone payment process, etc.)

community-led marketing campaigns to uphold brand integrity and
align with shared initiatives for ecosystem growth
attributes.proposal_benefit:
A community-led marketing fund allows for startups and marketers to showcase their innovations and engage with a broader audience through various mediums. The fund allows for fund/project distribution through a decentralized workforce, harnessing the power of community collaboration and utilizing the diverse skillsets of the Cardano ecosystem. 

- Create a specialized proposal system to allow
ecosystem projects and community members to launch Cardano marketing campaigns

- Ensure there is available funding for a wide range of
marketing budgets to promote diverse types of
campaigns throughout the global ecosystem

- Administer the process efficiently and fairly

- Develop standard operating procedures and
guidelines to uphold Cardano brand integrity,
proper project management, and fair use of spend

- Transparent reporting of successes, lessons learned,
and metrics regarding the overall community-led
funding program

Rare Network will administer a Community-Led Marketing Fund of $500,000 USD providing accessibility for the Cardano ecosystem to budgets from $1,000 to $30,000 USD, available for marketing campaign launches occurring July 1st, 2025 through March 31st , 2026.

This will benefit project teams who will bring decentralized exposure to the Cardano ecosystem who may have the skills to execute, but not the proper funding to produce. Properly administered community-led marketing has been proven worthy of spend, time and time again, if the project management to follow is executed properly. With Rare Network's expertise and trust built throughout the Cardano community, we can ensure that funds are utilized fairly and that marketing campaigns are carried out in a feasible and satisfying impactful fashion. 

The demonstrated value will be:

- Increased Brand Exposure Worldwide
- Scale via a Decentralized Workforce
- Showcase a wide variety of projects through diverse marketing campaign categories throughout regions globally
- Onboard more users and builders to the Cardano ecosystem
- Catch up to speed and compete with larger, equal, and smaller market cap blockchains who somehow have more spend and robust marketing strategies in place currently compared to Cardano (even some L2s spend more than Cardano who is a leading L1).
attributes.supplementary_endorsement:
Rare Network has been actively engaged in the Marketing Working Group since October of 2024, when we presented in collaboration with the Cardano Foundation at the Cardano Summit 2024 on an events strategy for 2025/2026. The presentation focused around collaboration between the founding entity marketing/events teams and ourselves, as the trusted/preferred community events, media, and marketing production vendor. 

The presentation evolved into a separate effort of fostering support to transcend the Marketing Working Group (MWG) operating under the MCC into it's own separate council, now known as the Growth & Marketing Committee (GMC). Rare Network, along with the MWG, Emurgo, Cardano Foundation, and Input Output, were instrumental in co-founding the GMC. 

Rare Network through the course of nearly a half year, campaigned on behalf of the MWG and it's constituents to bring the GMC to a reality. This was accomplished by nearly 30 half hour to full hour presentations and 12 versions of refinement based on feedback from these meetings of our original deck. These sessions took place with members of the Cardano community worldwide from experienced events hosts and marketers, to organizations, to dReps, to Intersect members, to founding entity leads, and all others in between. 

Presentations can be found from events like GM Cardano: 
https://www.youtube.com/live/Yk3-fW5PzuE?si=npF9dcoBGaN7RMDa&t=18816 

(latest presentation for reference on co-founding GMC (pre-budget finalization): https://acrobat.adobe.com/id/urn:aaid:sc:VA6C2:306c06ec-6996-4092-bcd4-4465c4e22b06)

Upon official formation of the GMC and completion of our charter, our efforts were geared towards establishing a proper events and marketing strategy, along with a budget. The group went through many more renditions and ultimately came to a finalized version that will help cover us for the remainder of 2025 and into 2026. 

With this background in mind, it is evident that we have the endorsement as a preferred services vendor by Intersect, the GMC operating within it, Cardano Foundation, Emurgo, and Input Output Global, along with this support remaining consistent throughout greater Cardano community's sentiment.
attributes.explain_proposal_roadmap:
Our proposal directly supports the Product Roadmap by fostering community-led engagement, increasing awareness, and strengthening the overall brand of Cardano. Through the Community-Led Marketing Fund, we empower ecosystem contributors and projects to produce impactful marketing campaigns that align with Cardano’s strategic direction.

Alignment with the Product Roadmap:

Ecosystem Growth & Adoption – By funding and supporting grassroots marketing campaigns, we increase user adoption, onboard new developers, and create networking opportunities that fuel ecosystem expansion.

Developer & Builder Engagement – Marketing campaigns will encourage developers to build on Cardano, ultimately contributing to the success of key product milestones.

Collaboration with Key Stakeholders – Our active coordination with the GMC, Product Committee, and Cardano’s Founding Entities ensures alignment with broader product goals and strategic initiatives.

Strengthening Cardano’s Brand – Well-executed marketing campaigns helps promote Cardano’s vision, technological advancements, and community-driven innovations, solidifying its reputation in the blockchain industry.

Feedback Loop for Product Development – Engagement via marketing campaigns serve as a direct channel for community feedback, allowing teams to refine product strategies, enhance usability, and address market needs effectively.

By leveraging our trusted position within the Cardano ecosystem and maintaining close collaboration with governance bodies, our initiative ensures that community-led marketing campaigns contribute meaningfully to the roadmap’s execution.

attributes.proposal_description:
Rare Network proposes the administration of a $500,000 USD Community-Led Marketing Fund to support Cardano ecosystem contributors produce diverse marketing campaigns globally. This initiative aims to position Cardano as a leader in blockchain by increasing visibility, engagement, and adoption.

 For the most optimal way to gain an understanding of our proposal, please see our deck first for visual: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1w_qzhCld5jRBFDUc8yHtir756rVFotMr

Challenges Identified
	· Lack of Cardano Marketing: Limited community-led marketing campaigns promoting the ecosystem.
	· Insufficient Funding: Compared to competitor Layer-1 blockchains, Cardano lacks financial support for grass roots marketing campaigns.
	· Inefficient Funding Mechanisms: Existing structures are impractical for marketing campaigns due to HR costs, overhead, and timing constraints.
	· Lack of SOPs: No standard operating procedures exist to maintain brand integrity and effective project management.

Proposed Solution
Rare Network will administer a marketing campaign fund allowing community members to launch meaningful marketing campaigns. The key components include:
	· Specialized Proposal System: Ensuring equitable access to funding.
	· Diverse Budget Allocation: Providing funds between $1,000 and $30,000 USD for a wide range of campaign scopes and budgets.
	· Efficient Administration: Ensuring fair distribution and transparent management.
	· Brand Integrity: Developing SOPs and brand guidelines to maintain alignment with Cardano’s values.
	· Transparent Reporting: Documenting successes, challenges, and impact.

Campaign Categories & Eligibility
Funding is open to individuals, organizations, and collaborations within the Cardano community. Marketing campaigns may include:
	· Product Launches
	· General Cardano Ecosystem Promotion
	· Content Creation
	· Social Media Campaigns
	· PR
	· Omnichannel Marketing Strategies


Funding Process
	1. Submit Proposal: Applications through an online portal.
	2. Review & Approval: Evaluation by Rare Network and shared with GMC/MWG for feedback.
	3. Fund Distribution: Dynamic allocation based on marketing campaign type and budgetary needs.
	4. Close-Out Report: Recipients must provide reports, KPIs, and media documentation.

Selection Criteria
	· Regional Diversity: Supporting marketing campaigns across different regions.
	· Marketing Experience: Ensuring high-quality execution.
	· Impact: Driving innovation and engagement.
	· Resource Optimization: Ensuring effective use of funds.

Administrative Costs & Timeline
	· A 15% administration fee will cover planning, proposal management, project management, and reporting to compensate Rare Network for their efforts.
	· Funding available from July 1, 2025 – March 31, 2026.

Strategic Alignment with Cardano’s Product Roadmap
	· Ecosystem Growth: Increasing exposure and driving global adoption.
	· Developer Engagement: Fostering marketing campaigns that not only target consumers, but also builders.
	· Collaboration: Aligning with the Growth & Marketing Committee (GMC), other Intersect committees, and Cardano’s founding entities.
	· Brand Strengthening: Showcasing Cardano’s innovation through impactful marketing campaigns.
	· Community Feedback Loop: Using marketing campaigns to refine strategies and improve ecosystem development.

Conclusion
Rare Network, a trusted partner within the Cardano ecosystem, has a proven track record of successfully managing community-driven initiatives. With endorsement from Intersect, GMC, Cardano Foundation, Emurgo, and IOG, this proposal ensures a sustainable, well-organized, and impactful community-led marketing campaign fund program.

attributes.problem_statement:
Without a coordinated and impactful marketing strategy,
Cardano risks being overshadowed in a competitive
landscape. A fresh approach to marketing is essential to
position Cardano as the leader in the blockchain space.

-Major lacking of omni-level marketing campaigns,
showcasing Cardano and those building on it at the community level
- Insufficient funding for community-led marketing in
comparison to competitor layer-1 blockchains
- The existing funding mechanisms are impractical for
the unique challenges of deploying marketing campaigns properly (ie. lack of working capital, HR payments during the work rather than retroactive, timed based on catalyst funding rounds and cumbersome milestone payment process, etc.)
- Lack of SOPs and best practices for producing Cardano
community-led marketing campaigns to uphold brand integrity and
align with shared initiatives for ecosystem growth
attributes.proposal_benefit:
A community-led marketing fund allows for startups and marketers to showcase their innovations and engage with a broader audience through various mediums. The fund allows for fund/project distribution through a decentralized workforce, harnessing the power of community collaboration and utilizing the diverse skillsets of the Cardano ecosystem. 

- Create a specialized proposal system to allow
ecosystem projects and community members to launch Cardano marketing campaigns

- Ensure there is available funding for a wide range of
marketing budgets to promote diverse types of
campaigns throughout the global ecosystem

- Administer the process efficiently and fairly

- Develop standard operating procedures and
guidelines to uphold Cardano brand integrity,
proper project management, and fair use of spend

- Transparent reporting of successes, lessons learned,
and metrics regarding the overall community-led
funding program

Rare Network will administer a Community-Led Marketing Fund of $500,000 USD providing accessibility for the Cardano ecosystem to budgets from $1,000 to $30,000 USD, available for marketing campaign launches occurring July 1st, 2025 through March 31st , 2026.

This will benefit project teams who will bring decentralized exposure to the Cardano ecosystem who may have the skills to execute, but not the proper funding to produce. Properly administered community-led marketing has been proven worthy of spend, time and time again, if the project management to follow is executed properly. With Rare Network's expertise and trust built throughout the Cardano community, we can ensure that funds are utilized fairly and that marketing campaigns are carried out in a feasible and satisfying impactful fashion. 

The demonstrated value will be:

- Increased Brand Exposure Worldwide
- Scale via a Decentralized Workforce
- Showcase a wide variety of projects through diverse marketing campaign categories throughout regions globally
- Onboard more users and builders to the Cardano ecosystem
- Catch up to speed and compete with larger, equal, and smaller market cap blockchains who somehow have more spend and robust marketing strategies in place currently compared to Cardano (even some L2s spend more than Cardano who is a leading L1).
attributes.supplementary_endorsement:
Rare Network has been actively engaged in the Marketing Working Group since October of 2024, when we presented in collaboration with the Cardano Foundation at the Cardano Summit 2024 on an events strategy for 2025/2026. The presentation focused around collaboration between the founding entity marketing/events teams and ourselves, as the trusted/preferred community events, media, and marketing production vendor. 

The presentation evolved into a separate effort of fostering support to transcend the Marketing Working Group (MWG) operating under the MCC into it's own separate council, now known as the Growth & Marketing Committee (GMC). Rare Network, along with the MWG, Emurgo, Cardano Foundation, and Input Output, were instrumental in co-founding the GMC. 

Rare Network through the course of nearly a half year, campaigned on behalf of the MWG and it's constituents to bring the GMC to a reality. This was accomplished by nearly 30 half hour to full hour presentations and 12 versions of refinement based on feedback from these meetings of our original deck. These sessions took place with members of the Cardano community worldwide from experienced events hosts and marketers, to organizations, to dReps, to Intersect members, to founding entity leads, and all others in between. 

Presentations can be found from events like GM Cardano: 
https://www.youtube.com/live/Yk3-fW5PzuE?si=npF9dcoBGaN7RMDa&t=18816 

(latest presentation for reference on co-founding GMC (pre-budget finalization): https://acrobat.adobe.com/id/urn:aaid:sc:VA6C2:306c06ec-6996-4092-bcd4-4465c4e22b06)

Upon official formation of the GMC and completion of our charter, our efforts were geared towards establishing a proper events and marketing strategy, along with a budget. The group went through many more renditions and ultimately came to a finalized version that will help cover us for the remainder of 2025 and into 2026. 

With this background in mind, it is evident that we have the endorsement as a preferred services vendor by Intersect, the GMC operating within it, Cardano Foundation, Emurgo, and Input Output Global, along with this support remaining consistent throughout greater Cardano community's sentiment.
attributes.explain_proposal_roadmap:
Our proposal directly supports the Product Roadmap by fostering community-led engagement, increasing awareness, and strengthening the overall brand of Cardano. Through the Community-Led Marketing Fund, we empower ecosystem contributors and projects to produce impactful marketing campaigns that align with Cardano’s strategic direction.

Alignment with the Product Roadmap:

Ecosystem Growth & Adoption – By funding and supporting grassroots marketing campaigns, we increase user adoption, onboard new developers, and create networking opportunities that fuel ecosystem expansion.

Developer & Builder Engagement – Marketing campaigns will encourage developers to build on Cardano, ultimately contributing to the success of key product milestones.

Collaboration with Key Stakeholders – Our active coordination with the GMC, Product Committee, and Cardano’s Founding Entities ensures alignment with broader product goals and strategic initiatives.

Strengthening Cardano’s Brand – Well-executed marketing campaigns helps promote Cardano’s vision, technological advancements, and community-driven innovations, solidifying its reputation in the blockchain industry.

Feedback Loop for Product Development – Engagement via marketing campaigns serve as a direct channel for community feedback, allowing teams to refine product strategies, enhance usability, and address market needs effectively.

By leveraging our trusted position within the Cardano ecosystem and maintaining close collaboration with governance bodies, our initiative ensures that community-led marketing campaigns contribute meaningfully to the roadmap’s execution.

attributes.proposal_description:
Rare Network proposes the administration of a $500,000 USD Community-Led Marketing Fund to support Cardano ecosystem contributors produce diverse marketing campaigns globally. This initiative aims to position Cardano as a leader in blockchain by increasing visibility, engagement, and adoption.

 For the most optimal way to gain an understanding of our proposal, please see our deck first for visual: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1w_qzhCld5jRBFDUc8yHtir756rVFotMr

Challenges Identified
	· Lack of Cardano Marketing: Limited community-led marketing campaigns promoting the ecosystem.
	· Insufficient Funding: Compared to competitor Layer-1 blockchains, Cardano lacks financial support for grass roots marketing campaigns.
	· Inefficient Funding Mechanisms: Existing structures are impractical for marketing campaigns due to HR costs, overhead, and timing constraints.
	· Lack of SOPs: No standard operating procedures exist to maintain brand integrity and effective project management.

Proposed Solution
Rare Network will administer a marketing campaign fund allowing community members to launch meaningful marketing campaigns. The key components include:
	· Specialized Proposal System: Ensuring equitable access to funding.
	· Diverse Budget Allocation: Providing funds between $1,000 and $30,000 USD for a wide range of campaign scopes and budgets.
	· Efficient Administration: Ensuring fair distribution and transparent management.
	· Brand Integrity: Developing SOPs and brand guidelines to maintain alignment with Cardano’s values.
	· Transparent Reporting: Documenting successes, challenges, and impact.

Campaign Categories & Eligibility
Funding is open to individuals, organizations, and collaborations within the Cardano community. Marketing campaigns may include:
	· Product Launches
	· General Cardano Ecosystem Promotion
	· Content Creation
	· Social Media Campaigns
	· PR
	· Omnichannel Marketing Strategies


Funding Process
	1. Submit Proposal: Applications through an online portal.
	2. Review & Approval: Evaluation by Rare Network and shared with GMC/MWG for feedback.
	3. Fund Distribution: Dynamic allocation based on marketing campaign type and budgetary needs.
	4. Close-Out Report: Recipients must provide reports, KPIs, and media documentation.

Selection Criteria
	· Regional Diversity: Supporting marketing campaigns across different regions.
	· Marketing Experience: Ensuring high-quality execution.
	· Impact: Driving innovation and engagement.
	· Resource Optimization: Ensuring effective use of funds.

Administrative Costs & Timeline
	· A 15% administration fee will cover planning, proposal management, project management, and reporting to compensate Rare Network for their efforts.
	· Funding available from July 1, 2025 – March 31, 2026.

Strategic Alignment with Cardano’s Product Roadmap
	· Ecosystem Growth: Increasing exposure and driving global adoption.
	· Developer Engagement: Fostering marketing campaigns that not only target consumers, but also builders.
	· Collaboration: Aligning with the Growth & Marketing Committee (GMC), other Intersect committees, and Cardano’s founding entities.
	· Brand Strengthening: Showcasing Cardano’s innovation through impactful marketing campaigns.
	· Community Feedback Loop: Using marketing campaigns to refine strategies and improve ecosystem development.

Conclusion
Rare Network, a trusted partner within the Cardano ecosystem, has a proven track record of successfully managing community-driven initiatives. With endorsement from Intersect, GMC, Cardano Foundation, Emurgo, and IOG, this proposal ensures a sustainable, well-organized, and impactful community-led marketing campaign fund program.

attributes.proposal_description:
Rare Network proposes the administration of a $500,000 USD Community-Led Marketing Fund to support Cardano ecosystem contributors produce diverse marketing campaigns globally. This initiative aims to position Cardano as a leader in blockchain by increasing visibility, engagement, and adoption.

Challenges Identified
	· Lack of Cardano Marketing: Limited community-led marketing campaigns promoting the ecosystem.
	· Insufficient Funding: Compared to competitor Layer-1 blockchains, Cardano lacks financial support for grass roots marketing campaigns.
	· Inefficient Funding Mechanisms: Existing structures are impractical for marketing campaigns due to HR costs, overhead, and timing constraints.
	· Lack of SOPs: No standard operating procedures exist to maintain brand integrity and effective project management.

Proposed Solution
Rare Network will administer a marketing campaign fund allowing community members to launch meaningful marketing campaigns. The key components include:
	· Specialized Proposal System: Ensuring equitable access to funding.
	· Diverse Budget Allocation: Providing funds between $1,000 and $30,000 USD for a wide range of campaign scopes and budgets.
	· Efficient Administration: Ensuring fair distribution and transparent management.
	· Brand Integrity: Developing SOPs and brand guidelines to maintain alignment with Cardano’s values.
	· Transparent Reporting: Documenting successes, challenges, and impact.

Campaign Categories & Eligibility
Funding is open to individuals, organizations, and collaborations within the Cardano community. Marketing campaigns may include:
	· Product Launches
	· General Cardano Ecosystem Promotion
	· Content Creation
	· Social Media Campaigns
	· PR
	· Omnichannel Marketing Strategies


Funding Process
	1. Submit Proposal: Applications through an online portal.
	2. Review & Approval: Evaluation by Rare Network and shared with GMC/MWG for feedback.
	3. Fund Distribution: Dynamic allocation based on marketing campaign type and budgetary needs.
	4. Close-Out Report: Recipients must provide reports, KPIs, and media documentation.

Selection Criteria
	· Regional Diversity: Supporting marketing campaigns across different regions.
	· Marketing Experience: Ensuring high-quality execution.
	· Impact: Driving innovation and engagement.
	· Resource Optimization: Ensuring effective use of funds.

Administrative Costs & Timeline
	· A 15% administration fee will cover planning, proposal management, project management, and reporting to compensate Rare Network for their efforts.
	· Funding available from July 1, 2025 – March 31, 2026.

Strategic Alignment with Cardano’s Product Roadmap
	· Ecosystem Growth: Increasing exposure and driving global adoption.
	· Developer Engagement: Fostering marketing campaigns that not only target consumers, but also builders.
	· Collaboration: Aligning with the Growth & Marketing Committee (GMC), other Intersect committees, and Cardano’s founding entities.
	· Brand Strengthening: Showcasing Cardano’s innovation through impactful marketing campaigns.
	· Community Feedback Loop: Using marketing campaigns to refine strategies and improve ecosystem development.

Conclusion
Rare Network, a trusted partner within the Cardano ecosystem, has a proven track record of successfully managing community-driven initiatives. With endorsement from Intersect, GMC, Cardano Foundation, Emurgo, and IOG, this proposal ensures a sustainable, well-organized, and impactful community-led marketing campaign fund program.
attributes.key_proposal_deliverables:
The following are the key deliverables to be carried out by Rare Network:

- Rare Network to deploy proposal platform and application process to the public. 
- Rare Network to screen proposers to ensure fair use of funds, feasibility, and impact
- Rare Network to approve qualified proposals 
- Rare Network to distribute funding throughout Q3-Q4 of 2025, as well as Q1 of 2026
- Rare Network will act as the program manager (high level project management, consultation, fund distribution, and reporting) of all approved and funded projects
- Rare Network will co-promote marketing campaigns if desired
- Rare Network will continue to develop the Cardano Community-Led Marketing Fund for future funding rounds and will knowledge transfer to a new vendor if necessary
- Rare Network will provide quarterly reports on progress of the fund

Ultimately, we will fund, manage, and report on dozens of community-led marketing campaigns, allowing us to stay competitive with other L1 blockchains who have robust marketing strategies and funding in 2025/26.
KPI's:

Social Follower Growth - Growth in followers, mentions, subs, engagement, etc.. on project's socials Measures wider visibility and interest in host project from the campaigns.

Number of Unique Engagements - Total unique individuals who participated Reflects the reach and inclusivity of the campaigns.

Number of Surveys Collected - Post-campaignssurvey giving direct insight into how community felt about campaigns

Localized Activations- New people reached from holding local campaigns Shows how global initiative can fuel the local ecosystem

New Collabs or Partnerships - People or projects working together as a direct result of the campaigns

Number of Ecosystem/Project 's that participated - Total number of projects who held campaigns

- Increased Brand Exposure Worldwide
- Scale via a Decentralized Workforce
- Showcase a wide variety of projects through diverse marketing campaign categories throughout regions globally
- Onboard more users and builders to the Cardano ecosystem
- Catch up to speed and compete with larger, equal, and smaller market cap blockchains who somehow have more spend and robust marketing strategies in place currently compared to Cardano (even some L2s spend more than Cardano who is a leading L1).

attributes.explain_proposal_roadmap:
Our proposal directly supports the Product Roadmap by fostering community-led engagement, increasing awareness, and strengthening the overall brand of Cardano. Through the Community-Led Marketing Fund, we empower ecosystem contributors and projects to produce impactful marketing campaigns that align with Cardano’s strategic direction.

Alignment with the Product Roadmap:

Ecosystem Growth & Adoption – By funding and supporting grassroots marketing campaigns, we increase user adoption, onboard new developers, and create networking opportunities that fuel ecosystem expansion.

Developer & Builder Engagement – Marketing campaigns will encourage developers to build on Cardano, ultimately contributing to the success of key product milestones.

Collaboration with Key Stakeholders – Our active coordination with the GMC, Product Committee, and Cardano’s Founding Entities ensures alignment with broader product goals and strategic initiatives.

Strengthening Cardano’s Brand – Well-executed marketing campaigns helps promote Cardano’s vision, technological advancements, and community-driven innovations, solidifying its reputation in the blockchain industry.

Feedback Loop for Product Development – Engagement via marketing campaigns serve as a direct channel for community feedback, allowing teams to refine product strategies, enhance usability, and address market needs effectively.

By leveraging our trusted position within the Cardano ecosystem and maintaining close collaboration with governance bodies, our initiative ensures that community-led marketing campaigns contribute meaningfully to the roadmap’s execution.
